text: Climate policy changed after the monsoon report because farmers needed early warning systems. The government announced a new framework for agricultural resilience including drought-resistant crop subsidies and rural weather station networks. Scientists at IIT Bombay confirmed that rainfall patterns have shifted significantly over the past decade.

The history of Indian classical music spans over two thousand years. Hindustani and Carnatic traditions diverged around the twelfth century when Persian influences reached northern courts. Ragas encode not just melodic material but the time of day and season in which they should be performed. Modern fusion explores these boundaries while preserving the fundamental structure of raga grammar.

Plate tectonics explains how Earth's outer shell breaks into moving plates that carry the continents across the globe. The Deccan Traps formed when India drifted over a mantle hotspot roughly 65 million years ago. This volcanic episode may have contributed to the mass extinction event. Modern GPS measurements track plate velocities to millimetre precision, confirming drift rates of several centimetres per year.

Open source software has transformed how technology spreads globally. The Linux kernel, released in 1991, now runs most internet servers, Android phones and supercomputers. Permissive licences like MIT and Apache allow commercial use while copyleft licences like GPL require derivative works to remain open. Choosing the right licence is a fundamental engineering and legal decision for any project.

Economic research shows that infrastructure investment in rural areas creates sustainable employment and reduces migration to cities. A study of road construction programs in Bihar and Odisha found that villages within five kilometres of new roads showed 23 percent higher household income after five years. Digital infrastructure including mobile networks and broadband amplifies these effects.

Quantum computing differs fundamentally from classical computing. A qubit can exist in a superposition of zero and one until measured, unlike a classical bit which is always one or the other. Grover's algorithm provides a quadratic speedup for unstructured search. Shor's algorithm solves integer factorisation in polynomial time, threatening current public-key cryptography systems.

Biodiversity loss is accelerating at rates not seen since the last mass extinction. The IPBES report estimates one million species face extinction within decades. Protected area networks cover only 17 percent of land surface. Corridor conservation connects fragmented habitats allowing species to migrate as climate zones shift. Indigenous land stewardship has often proved more effective than centrally managed reserves.

The Mumbai-Ahmedabad High Speed Rail corridor will reduce travel time from over six hours to under three. Engineers face the challenge of building a largely elevated track across the Thane creek and through coastal zones. Japanese Shinkansen technology adapted for Indian conditions requires extensive localisation of maintenance practices, worker training and spare part supply chains.

def train(model, loader, optimizer, loss_fn, device):
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0.0
    for batch_idx, (input_ids, targets, loss_mask) in enumerate(loader):
        input_ids = input_ids.to(device)
        targets = targets.to(device)
        loss_mask = loss_mask.to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        logits = model(input_ids)
        loss = loss_fn(logits.view(-1, logits.size(-1)), targets.view(-1))
        loss = (loss * loss_mask.view(-1)).sum() / loss_mask.sum()
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        total_loss += loss.item()
    return total_loss / len(loader)

भारत में भाषा और तकनीक का मिलन तेजी से बढ़ रहा है। कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता के क्षेत्र में हिंदी और अन्य भारतीय भाषाओं के लिए नए मॉडल विकसित हो रहे हैं। संगठन जैसे AI4Bharat ने संग्रह जैसे डेटासेट बनाए हैं जो भारतीय भाषाओं के लिए प्रशिक्षण डेटा प्रदान करते हैं। यह काम भारतीय उपयोगकर्ताओं के लिए सुलभ और प्रभावी AI समाधान बनाने में मदद करता है।

తెలుగు వార్తలు: ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ మరియు తెలంగాణ రాష్ట్రాలలో వ్యవసాయ రంగం అభివృద్ధి చెందుతోంది. కొత్త సాంకేతికతలు రైతులకు సహాయపడుతున్నాయి. డ్రోన్ సర్వే మరియు మట్టి పరీక్ష కార్యక్రమాలు పంట దిగుబడిని పెంచడంలో కీలక పాత్ర పోషిస్తున్నాయి. ప్రభుత్వం కొత్త నీటి పారుదల పద్ధతులను ప్రోత్సహిస్తోంది.

ਪੰਜਾਬ ਵਿੱਚ ਖੇਤੀਬਾੜੀ ਦੀ ਤਬਦੀਲੀ: ਨਵੀਂ ਤਕਨੀਕਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਡਿਜੀਟਲ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਣਾਲੀਆਂ ਕਿਸਾਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਮਦਦ ਕਰ ਰਹੀਆਂ ਹਨ। ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਈਵੇਟ ਭਾਈਵਾਲੀ ਨੇ ਸਿੱਧੇ ਲਾਭ ਟ੍ਰਾਂਸਫਰ ਪ੍ਰੋਗਰਾਮਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਲਾਗੂ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ। ਮੋਬਾਈਲ ਐਪਲੀਕੇਸ਼ਨਾਂ ਕਿਸਾਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਮੌਸਮ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਬਾਜ਼ਾਰ ਭਾਅ ਉਪਲਬਧ ਕਰਾਉਂਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ।

কৃত্রিম বুদ্ধিমত্তা বাংলা ভাষার জন্য নতুন সুযোগ তৈরি করছে। ভারত এবং বাংলাদেশের গবেষকরা মিলে বাংলা এনএলপি মডেল তৈরি করছেন। প্রাকৃতিক ভাষা প্রক্রিয়াকরণ প্রযুক্তি বাংলা টেক্সট বিশ্লেষণ, অনুবাদ এবং প্রশ্নোত্তর সিস্টেমে ব্যবহার হচ্ছে।

ಕನ್ನಡ ಭಾಷೆಯ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಯುಗ: ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೃತಕ ಬುದ್ಧಿಮತ್ತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಯಂತ್ರ ಕಲಿಕೆ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತಿದೆ. ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನ ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನ ಕಂಪನಿಗಳು ಕನ್ನಡ ಧ್ವನಿ ಗುರುತಿಸುವ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಗಳನ್ನು ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿಪಡಿಸುತ್ತಿವೆ. ಮೊಬೈಲ್ ಅಪ್ಲಿಕೇಶನ್‌ಗಳು ಕನ್ನಡ ಬಳಕೆದಾರರಿಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸುಲಭವಾಗುತ್ತಿವೆ.

मराठी भाषेतील तंत्रज्ञानाची प्रगती: महाराष्ट्रात डिजिटल क्रांती वेगाने होत आहे. मराठी भाषेसाठी ऑटोमॅटिक स्पीच रेकग्निशन आणि मशीन ट्रान्सलेशन सिस्टम विकसित केल्या जात आहेत. शेती, शिक्षण आणि आरोग्य या क्षेत्रात AI चा वापर वाढत आहे. मराठी डेटासेट्स तयार करणे हे या कामाचा महत्त्वाचा भाग आहे।

EVAL: Count integers between 1 and 1000 divisible by neither 3 nor 7. By inclusion-exclusion: 1000 - floor(1000/3) - floor(1000/7) + floor(1000/21) = 1000 - 333 - 142 + 47 = 572. Answer: 572.
